global_memory.search.purpose: Find personal identity information shared across chats.

chat_ledger.search.purpose: Find earlier messages in the current chat.

document.search.purpose: Search text in document attachments belonging to the current chat.

document.image.inspect.purpose: Inspect one embedded image inside one document attachment by its one-based document image order.

arguments.attachment_ids: array containing exactly one allowed document attachment id

vision.inspect.purpose: Inspect pixels in image attachments belonging to this chat, including earlier uploads when needed.

artifact.generate.purpose: Generate downloadable documents or a presentation and attach them to the current chat.

arguments.formats: array containing only the explicitly requested formats: docx, pptx, and/or pdf
arguments.output_filename: optional exact output filename for PDF; supplied by the fixed PDF workflow

content.title: string
content.subtitle: optional string
content.sections: array of {heading: string, paragraphs: array of strings, bullets: array of strings}
content.slides: optional array of {title: string, body: string, bullets: array of strings}; use for PPTX when requested

rules: Use this action only when the user explicitly asks for a file or export.
Create only the requested format or formats. If the user asks for all supported formats, request docx, pptx, and pdf.
Put the complete requested content in the file. Do not merely convert a short acknowledgement.
For PPTX, make each slide cover one clear point and keep text concise.
For DOCX or PDF, organize the material into useful titled sections.
